## v1.41.0

`mgmt.doctorProbe` can now probe agents that call client tools. It answers a waiting tool for you, so the turn no longer stalls until the tool timeout. The probe can also return the reply text and ignore symbols you allow. Nothing breaks: every new option is optional and every new result field is additive.

### Added

- `doctorProbe` accepts `clientTools`: an object keyed by tool name. Each value is a JSON answer, or a function `(args, call) => answer` (sync or async). The probe sends it when the agent waits for that tool. (#493)
- The reply reports `toolAcks` (one entry per answered tool, with `ok` and a `reason` on failure) and `unansweredTools` (waiting tools that had no answer). (#493)
- On a timeout, `error.unansweredTools` lists the waiting tools. The message names them and shows the `clientTools` key to pass. (#493)
- `doctorProbe` accepts `includeText: true`. The reply then carries `text`. (#493)
- `spoken.allowSymbols` takes any of `% $ & € £ #` and leaves them out of `reply.spoken.symbols`. `reply.spoken.digitRuns` lists the digit runs found, so you can allow `2026` and flag `183`. `digits` is unchanged. (#493)
- The `client_tool_wait_blocks` fix text points to `clientTools`. (#493)

### Docs

- `docs/DOCTOR.md` has a "Client tools that wait" section and rows for the new fields. (#493)
- `docs/EAR-TEST-RECIPE.md` is a recipe to hear how a voice says a number, an acronym or a name, using only the public API. (#493)
- `catalog.createVoice`, `docs/api/design.md`, `docs/LANGUAGES.md` and the README now say how to find a voice's TTS provider and that `language` is a label. (#493)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kaltura/intelligent-agents-sdk/compare/v1.40.0...v1.41.0
